correctness.rationale: Aoki's exact saturated-pair formula reduces equality in the n-1 bound to a nonnegative defect identity with total defect one. Its four exhaustive cases yield precisely the double-star family, K_{2,n-2}, and its dual; explicit saturated pairs of weight n-1 prove every converse. The relative Auslander formula gives the equivalent interval-resolution statement.

originality.rationale: To the best of our knowledge, the recent source proves the sharp bound and gives one star extremizer but does not classify equality. Targeted searches found no prior classification of all posets attaining gldim Lambda_P=n-1 or interval-resolution global dimension n-3. Earlier inspected work classifies the zero endpoint instead.

value.rationale: The theorem converts a sharpness example into a complete structural equality classification, transfers the classification to interval-resolution global dimension, and counts all extremal isomorphism types.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
